programmes.title: Synthetic audiences / Electric Twin research programme
programmes.what: Issues #29-#52: capability lineage, validation claims, deployments, vendor dependence, professional rules, market map, clinical-trial digital twins.
programmes.came_from: GitHub issues #29-#52 (bodies and 86 comments from `retrospective/2026-10-12/github/`), receipts mechanically extracted; plus the 5 files of PR #50's branch `agent/synthetic-population-fanout`.
programmes.found: Electric Twin's "96% independently validated" claim traces to a paper whose evaluator is the vendor's science adviser and shareholder (benchmark private, no replication package); Times ExplorAItion is screening and supplementation plus one vendor-claimed bounded partial substitution, not full replacement; the EMA qualified only PROCOVA's linear prognostic adjustment; no vendor names its model, cloud or subprocessors; a 77-source market screen found no public joined campaign receipt.

programmes.found: Deed chronology re-derived (Alexan Azalea block bought 2018-01-24 for $25.6M); the Downtown Arcadia Improvement Association is a 2013 nonprofit (FY2025 revenue $160,121), not a statutory district; the "1993 Downtown Revitalization Strategy" was not found; the first documented Positive Investments purchase came 22 months after the train, not before it (the 2024 Alexan-site grantor stays an open question).
